subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the migration delete them when the suffix scheme changes?
rationale: Config backups may be the user's only recovery copy, and repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than automation-only.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
options.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the timestamped retention set without silently deleting useful backups.

options.title: Prune Legacy Numbered Backups
options.body: Accept that first-run cleanup after the change may delete existing numbered backups in exchange for a clean timestamp-only scheme.

options.title: Keep Numeric Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change for now and document the numbered ring as the intended stable behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the timestamped retention set without silently deleting useful backups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history around config backup and recovery semantics and is the best available owner for the upgrade-behavior choice.
